title: IntakePackage
description: Canonical, intent-level representation produced by PCA intake adapters. Every intake form (idea, paragraph, PRD, ticket, feedback, bug, text workflow; Phase 2: Figma/screenshot/Loom/diagram) normalizes into this single shape. Intent only - what the intake ASSERTS. Never code reality (CCA) and never authored design (UX agent). Embedded in the intake_assessment artifact for audit.

sources.description: One entry per raw intake artifact ingested.

source_type.description: Phase 1 = the text types; figma/screenshot/loom/workflow_diagram are Phase 2.

origin_ref.description: Where it came from (file path, URL, ticket key).

content_hash.description: Optional hash of the raw content for provenance.

adapter.description: The adapter that normalized this source.

normalized_text.description: Unified, normalized statement of intent across all sources.

extracted_signals.description: ASSERTED intent extracted from the intake, used to fill Brief fields + seed the handoff. Each key is always present (possibly empty).

actors.description: Roles the intake mentions (intent, not code actors).

stated_rules.description: Business rules explicit in the intake.

attachments.description: References to rich intake carried forward for later stages (Phase 2 populated). Referenced, never re-modeled.

mixed.description: True when intake combines multiple source artifacts.
